summary: Implemented generator support for on_setattr hooks. Added _IS_GENERATOR_RESULTS cache and _lazy_is_generator to _compat.py (lazy inspect import, tolerates non-hashable hooks). Changed _ClassBuilder.add_setattr in _make.py to store (attribute, hook, _lazy_is_generator(hook)) and generate a __setattr__ that either sets directly, runs the generator path (next -> _OBJ_SETATTR -> next; StopIteration ends, second yield closes generator and raises RuntimeError), or keeps the plain hook behaviour. Added docstrings/versionchanged notes in _make.attrib, _next_gen.define/field, a pipe() warning in setters.py, Generator in _OnSetAttrType in attrs/__init__.pyi, and a new doctest section in docs/examples.md. Check command passes: 52 passed, 1 xfailed.
concerns: the last attempt hit the turn limit; the checks pass, but the work may be unfinished
Hooks determined to be generators via inspect.isgeneratorfunction are cached, so a hook's generator-ness is fixed after first set.
The generator path yields into _OBJ_SETATTR before checking for a second yield, so a double-yielding hook leaves the first value set (matches the test).
